rows.quote: The case definition of rheumatoid arthritis in the UK Biobank cohort was based on any of three criteria: (1) hospital discharge or death certificate with an International Classification of Diseases diagnostic code for rheumatoid arthritis; (2) any primary care diagnosis of rheumatoid arthritis; or (3) self‐reported diagnosis of rheumatoid arthritis supported by prescription of a disease‐modifying antirheumatic drug at baseline or during follow‐up.
rows.coder_note: Rule C: the authors' own analysis of UK Biobank individual-level data, defined by the pinned case definition, the application number (23652, p001), the analytic sample (487,152 individuals, 5,958 cases, p002) and a described procedure (logistic regression, p005); no dictionary row is this dataset.
